hints.title: Build Child to Parent Mapping
hints.text: In each region list, the first element is the parent of all subsequent regional elements.

hints.title: Trace Ancestors of Region 1
hints.text: Climb up the parent hierarchy starting from region1, adding each ancestor into a lookup collection.

hints.title: Climb from Region 2 Until First Match
hints.text: Follow the parent chain from region2; the first node already present in the collection is the lowest common ancestor.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: total number of regions across all lists
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching paths from roots downwards takes multiple tree traversals and path comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bottom-up parent traversal finds the lowest common ancestor in linear time proportional to tree depth.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should model the input as a directed tree with upward parent pointers.
complexity.notes: Guaranteed that a common region always exists.
